LanguageData.SSC_RES_UterusDevelopment.label: PNA internal organ reshaping
LanguageData.SSC_RES_UterusDevelopment.description: Blend concentrated aphrodisiac nanofluid with medicine into a preparation that can remain dormant for a long time. Its potency will not seep away on the journey deep into the body, only taking effect once it reaches the intended organ. In this way, its aphrodisiac power can be firmly planted in the body's deepest recesses, reshaping the organs within, little by little.
